name: callmap
description: PR-delta callgraph viewer for code reviewers — npm workspaces monorepo (core + ui + desktop + vscode).

scripts.typecheck: npm -w @callmap/core run typecheck && npm -w @callmap/ui run typecheck && npm -w @callmap/desktop run typecheck && npm -w callmap-vscode run typecheck
scripts.build: npm -w @callmap/core run build && npm -w @callmap/ui run typecheck && npm -w @callmap/desktop run build && npm -w callmap-vscode run build
